verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a large first-party catalog: 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools, a dedicated MCP server per app, and an 'App marketplace' with per-app pages listing tool counts and capability summaries. That supports browsing what exists before wiring it into an agent. There is no evidence of a search or filter-by-capability interface over that catalog, and it only covers Pipedream's own servers rather than a general MCP registry. missing for 10: documented search/filter by capability, catalog browsing UX/API details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent
